patterns: A fence across a promised mourning road wakes a flood rider. Recover the shared agreement, evacuate threatened families and restore a passage people can actually use.
An extra midnight carriage carries workers erased from the timetable. Repair its brake lantern, find an unpaid builder and bring the lost crew to a present-day platform.
New gold pulses with miners' heartbeats and poisons the town well. Test the living vein, rescue lower-gallery workers and choose a livelihood above the dangerous shaft.

scenes:
A Fence across the Mourning Road|Objective: stop the flood threat. Pull unlawful stakes or escort evacuees; delay floods the first homes
One Carriage Too Many|Objective: identify the extra coach. Count passengers or compare departure logs; delay reaches the ghost bridge
Gold with a Heartbeat|Objective: establish the ore's danger. Test the nugget or compare patient pulses; delay taints another water jar
The Survey's Missing Leaf|Objective: prove shared passage. Recover the agreement or call both-bank witnesses; delay burns the survey copy
The Station that Was Erased|Objective: reach Platform Zero. Admit the wage debt or repair the destination ticket; delay changes the carriage's year
Voices in the Listening Shaft|Objective: protect lower-gallery miners. Follow their signals or isolate the ore stores; delay opens another fault
Dry Ground before Judgment|Objective: evacuate threatened families. Stage wagons or anchor the rope crossing; delay cuts off the last shelter
The Brake Lantern Bridge|Objective: cross safely with the workers. Repair the lamp or detach cargo first; delay rolls the coach backward
Water without Gold|Objective: keep the town supplied. Open the clean reserve or test an alternate well; delay spreads the ore bloom
The County Gunhand's Order|Objective: stop coercion at the hearing. Withdraw the survey order or secure a public witness; delay isolates the neighbors
The Builder's Unpaid Years|Objective: settle wages and acknowledgment. Publish the wage book or secure a union payment; delay strands the builder
A Living Vein's Return|Objective: remove the source of illness. Return ore or isolate the unsafe gallery; delay names another miner
Two Banks at the Hearing|Objective: renew a usable crossing. Preserve shared passage or create a witnessed limited route; delay restarts the fence work
A Platform in the Present|Objective: bring the crew home. Record the station or guide workers with the rail lamp; delay erases the passenger list
No Fortune beneath the Well|Objective: close without abandoning workers. Fund surface shifts or a clean food reserve; delay reopens the shaft in secret
The Road after the Flood|Objective: settle the boundary. Restore the mourning route and repair homes or witness a shared crossing; record losses and duties
The Midnight Homecoming|Objective: end the railway debt. Pay the named crew or agree a witnessed schedule; record the true station and years
A Town above Ground|Objective: settle the mine's future. Seal the listening shaft or maintain bounded safe isolation; record water tests and alternative work
